QuestInfo.name: The Ultimate Soup
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Do created a soup that can reinvigorate people suffering from the heat, but he lost the recipe in Tae Sang's backyard. He says to search in a red box beneath the peach tree there. To enter Tae Sang's House, you need #e#bTae Sang's Emblem#k#n, which Tae Sang ALSO lost. Defeat monsters to find the emblem so you can retrieve that recipe!
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Obtain #bTae Sang's Emblem#k from monsters, go to Tae Sang's backyard, and search the wooden box underneath the peach tree.

0.0: I've created a delicious soup that will make anyone who drinks it instantly cool and refreshed. Only...I left the recipe in Tae Sang's backyard. My friend, some things are better left unasked. Now, will you retrieve my recipe for me?

yes.0: Head to the backyard of Tae Sang's House. You'll find a pink peach tree. Beneath it is a wooden box. Inside that box should be my recipe. Again, my friend. Do not ask.

no.0: Why do you look upon me with suspicion in your eyes?!
